text: Print geometry: trim, bleed (≈3mm/8.5pt), safe area (≈5mm/14pt); bleed()/safe_area()/bg() ride a #page: modify line; print_ready report gates (edge art to bleed, bleed present, text in safe area, font/PPI/licence folds); reader-order pages for booklets; CMYK only on print intent.
When a document is destined for PHYSICAL PRINT … the design must survive CUTTING … Edge art extends to the bleed line … Keep copy inside safe_area.
When the user explicitly asks for bleed/crop marks baked into the design itself, use skills/print-bleed-marks.
note: BROKEN REFERENCE: print-bleed-marks is legacy-only, not in the scene view.

text: Digital-only surfaces (social ads, LinkedIn) need NONE of this: no bleed, no safe area beyond taste margins. Do not add print geometry to digital documents.
PNG export … is the preferred critic artifact … The visual reviewer should reject designs that are clipped, mis-scaled, off-canvas, unreadable, or visibly incomplete even when export succeeds.
note: Written for the trio's reviewer and for a runtime checklist; most of this file describes runtime checks, not agent work. Nothing links here.
